en.输入新 Token 以替换；留空保留现有 Token。已保存的 Token 不会: Enter a new Token to replace it, or leave blank to keep the current Token. Saved Tokens are never shown.
en.选择运行任务的目录。浏览的是 DSH 主机上的文件夹。: Choose the directory for running tasks. These folders are on the DSH host.
en.必填；每行一个 ID，也可用逗号分隔。只有这些用户能调用机器人。: Required. Enter one ID per line or separate them with commas. Only these users can use the bot.
en.每行一个 ID，也可用逗号分隔。留空禁用频道消息，私聊由下方开关控制。: Enter one ID per line or separate them with commas. Leave blank to disable channel messages; private messages use the switch below.
en.私聊仍受用户白名单限制。: Private messages still require an allowed user.
en.开启后，在白名单频道中直接 @机器人并发送正文即可对话；仅识别实际选择的当前机器: When enabled, select and @mention the current bot with your message in an allowed channel. Only direct mentions of this bot trigger it, not @everyone or role mentions. Turning this off does not disable automatic forwarding if that is enabled.
en.开启后，白名单频道中的普通消息会自动进入 DSH；关闭时可使用命令前缀，或在启用: When enabled, ordinary messages in allowed channels go to DSH automatically. When off, use the command prefix or directly @mention the bot if mention wakeup is enabled.
en.陌生人配对审批: Require pairing approval for new users
en.陌生人私聊先收到配对码，主人批准后才能使用。: New users receive a pairing code in private messages and must be approved by the owner before using the bot.
en.用于接收陌生人配对请求和批准通知。: Receives pairing requests and approval notifications for new users.
en.描述长期人格、语气、边界和回答风格。: Describe the bot's ongoing personality, tone, boundaries and response style.
en.按用户独立保存；数值越大，模型看到的记忆越多。: Saved separately for each user. Higher values give the model more memories.
en.记忆权重每经过这些月数衰减一半，数值越大衰退越慢。: Memory weight halves after this many months. Higher values make memories fade more slowly.
en.选择 UTF-8 TXT 或 Markdown 文件，最大 1 MiB。导入的是: Choose a UTF-8 TXT or Markdown file up to 1 MiB. The imported content is a snapshot; import again after changing the original.
en.根据用户问题做简单关键词检索。: Uses simple keyword matching against the user's question.
en.例如 /dsh；不能包含空格。: For example, /dsh. Spaces are not allowed.
en.默认自动保存到工作目录；通常无需修改。: Saved in the workspace by default. Usually no changes are needed.
en.从 DSH 已配置的预设中选择。: Choose from the presets configured in DSH.
en.跟随默认时，在会话创建或恢复时读取 DSH 默认模型及推理等级。: When following defaults, new and resumed sessions use the DSH default model and reasoning level.
en.保存后的模型选择会用于新会话和恢复的旧会话；显式指定模型时使用该模型默认推理等级: The saved selection applies to new and resumed sessions. An explicitly selected model uses its default reasoning level.
en.仅未填写 Bot Token 时使用。变量应在 DSH 启动前设置。: Used only when no Bot Token is configured. Set the variable before starting DSH.
en.工作目录必须是 DSH 主机上的绝对路径。: The workspace must be an absolute path on the DSH host.
en.请至少填写一个允许的用户 ID。: Enter at least one allowed user ID.
en.用户和频道 ID 必须仅包含数字。: User and channel IDs must contain digits only.
en.命令前缀不能为空或包含空格。: The command prefix cannot be empty or contain spaces.
en.请填写会话映射文件路径。: Enter a path for the session mapping file.
en.供应商和模型名称必须一起填写或一起留空。: Specify both the provider and model name, or leave both blank.
en.记忆和知识库限制必须是有效整数。: Memory and knowledge limits must be valid integers.
en.启用配对审批时，请填写主人的 KOOK 用户 ID。: Enter the owner's KOOK user ID to enable pairing approval.
en.记忆条数最多 50，半衰期最多 120 个月，知识条数最多 20。: Limits: 50 memories, a 120-month half-life and 20 knowledge entries.
en.无法打开系统目录选择器，请使用目录浏览。: Could not open the system folder picker. Use the folder browser instead.
en.请选择不超过 1 MiB 的 UTF-8 TXT 或 Markdown 文件。: Choose a UTF-8 TXT or Markdown file no larger than 1 MiB.
en.知识文件已读入，保存设置后生效。: Knowledge file imported. Save settings to apply it.
en.文件为空或不是有效的 UTF-8 文本，请转换编码后重试。: The file is empty or is not valid UTF-8 text. Convert its encoding and try again.
en.保存未被接受，可能是配置已被其他页面修改。请重新载入后检查并保存。: Save was not accepted. Another page may have changed the settings. Reload, review and save again.
en.设置已保存，KOOK 连接将应用新配置。: Settings saved. The KOOK connection will apply the new configuration.
en.保存失败，请检查 DSH 连接后重试。: Save failed. Check the DSH connection and try again.
en.KOOK 配置尚不可用。请确认 KOOK 主机插件已启用且配置条目 ID 为 k: KOOK settings are unavailable. Make sure the KOOK host plugin is enabled and its configuration entry ID is kook.
en.使用先前配置的主机知识文件: Using the previously configured knowledge file on the host
en.配置机器人连接、访问权限与对话方式。: Configure the bot connection, access and conversations.
en.当前 DSH 配置只读，无法保存修改。: DSH settings are read-only. Changes cannot be saved.
en.配置已在其他位置更新。请重新载入后再编辑。: Settings changed elsewhere. Reload before editing.
en.已保存 Token 覆盖值，可能包括主动停用时保存的空值；此状态不代表机器人已连: A Token override is saved, possibly an empty value saved to disable the bot. This does not mean the bot is connected.
en.未保存 Token 覆盖值，将尝试使用主机环境变量。: No Token override is saved. The host environment variable will be tried.
en.以下操作在保存设置后生效。清除 Token 会停用连接。: These actions take effect when you save settings. Clearing the Token disables the connection.
en.保存后清除 Token 并停止连接。: Saving will clear the Token and stop the connection.
en.保存后移除 Token 覆盖，使用环境变量。: Saving will remove the Token override and use the environment variable.
en.部分模型列表不可用，请检查 DSH 模型配置后刷新。已保存的选择会保留。: Some model lists are unavailable. Check DSH model settings and refresh. Your saved selection will be kept.
en.预设列表不可用，请检查 DSH 预设服务。: The preset list is unavailable. Check the DSH preset service.
en.也可只 @机器人并附图，不填写问题；机器人会结合上下文查看图片，没有其他问题时简: You can also @mention the bot and attach an image without a question. The bot uses the conversation context, or briefly describes the image when there is no other question.
en.在同一条消息中实际 @机器人、添加图片并填写问题即可识图；无需先发 /image: Select and @mention the bot, attach an image and add your question in the same message. No /image command is needed first. Choose the bot account, not a role with the same name.
en.同条图片消息中的问题优先使用；即使同时写 /image <问题>，也会直接处理当: The question in the image message takes priority. Even with /image <question> in that message, the current image is processed immediately rather than waiting for another one.
en.私聊可直接发送图片和问题，不需要 @；也可先发送 /image <问题>，再在两: In private messages, send the image and question directly without an @mention. You can also send /image <question> first, then the image within two minutes.
en.分开两次发送时，请先实际选择机器人并发送 @机器人 /image <问题>，再由: For two separate messages, select the bot and send @bot /image <question>, then send the image from the same account in the same channel within two minutes. You can also use the command prefix below:
en.看图需要支持图片的模型。支持 PNG、JPEG、WebP、GIF，单张最多 8: Image input requires a compatible model. PNG, JPEG, WebP and GIF are supported, up to 8 MiB each, subject to DSH image limits.
en.需要图片回复时，可以要求机器人把工作目录内已有的图片发到当前聊天。: To receive an image reply, ask the bot to send an existing image from the workspace to the current chat.
en.选择 DSH 主机目录: Choose a folder on the DSH host
en.无法读取目录，请检查主机目录浏览服务或重试。: Could not read the folder. Check the host folder browser service or try again.
en.目录较多，列表仅显示部分内容。: Only some entries are shown because this folder contains many items.
en.保存会重连机器人并停止当前 KOOK 任务，请等回答结束后再保存。: Saving reconnects the bot and stops current KOOK tasks. Wait for the reply to finish before saving.
en.日常配置已移至左下角账号菜单中的“设置 → KOOK”。: Everyday settings have moved to Settings → KOOK in the account menu at the bottom left.
en.在设置中管理机器人连接、权限、模型和图片对话。本页保留启用、停用和版本管理。: Manage the bot connection, access, models and image conversations in Settings. Use this page to enable, disable and manage versions.
